title: Warm Molten Slovakian Nectarines Pancakes
description: A unique Slovakian dish featuring caramelized nectarines, dehydrated to intensify their flavor. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Dehydrate sliced nectarines in a single layer on a baking sheet at 140°F (60°C) for 2 hours.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, sugar, cinnamon powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together almond milk, eggs, melted butter, vanilla extract, honey, and thyme.
Slowly pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the pancakes to a baking dish and top with dehydrated nectarines.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the pancakes are golden brown and the nectarines are caramelized.
Serve warm with additional honey and thyme if desired.
